# [Question]: reference.chunks.positions numbers meaning
## Timeline
> Hi @bryantomadon! I'm [Dosu](https://go.dosu.dev/dosubot) and I’m helping the ragflow team.The numbers in reference.chunks.positions represent the physical location of a chunk within a visual document (such as a PDF, figure, table, or image). Each array follows the format: [page, left, right, top, bottom].
For your example, [204, 26, 540, 160, 334] means:204: the page number (1-based index)26: the left coordinate of the bounding box540: the right coordinate160: the top coordinate334: the bottom coordinateThese coordinates define a rectangle on the specified page that contains the chunk's content.
This structure is used throughout RAGFlow to track and reference the exact position of content in visual documents, which is especially useful for rendering highlights or extracting context in your frontend.
